(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][AfterImageBlurStep]";

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.afterimageBlurStep";

const SFX_URL = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind2.ogg";

// -----------------------------

// Helpers

// -----------------------------

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) => {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

function wait(ms) {

return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

}

function resolveTokenEntry(entry) {

if (!entry) return null;

// TokenDocument -> Token placeable

if (entry?.object) return entry.object;

// Token placeable

if (entry?.center && entry?.document) return entry;

if (typeof entry === "string") {

// UUID path

const doc = fromUuidSync?.(entry);

if (doc?.object) return doc.object; // TokenDocument

if (doc?.center && doc?.document) return doc; // Token placeable

if (doc?.documentName === "Actor") {

return doc.getActiveTokens?.(true, true)?.[0] ?? null;

}

if (doc?.actor?.getActiveTokens) {

return doc.actor.getActiveTokens(true, true)?.[0] ?? null;

}

// Scene token id fallback

const sceneTok = canvas.tokens?.get?.(entry);

if (sceneTok) return sceneTok;

}

return null;

}

function resolveSourceToken() {

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const candidates = [

p?.sourceToken,

p?.casterToken,

p?.token,

p?._sourceToken,

p?.meta?.sourceToken,

p?.meta?.casterToken,

p?.action?.sourceToken,

p?.action?.casterToken,

p?.sourceTokenUuid,

p?.casterTokenUuid,

p?.tokenUuid,

p?.tokenUUID,

p?.attackerUuid,

p?.attackerUUID,

p?.meta?.attackerUuid,

p?.meta?.attackerUUID

].filter(Boolean);

for (const c of candidates) {

const tok = resolveTokenEntry(c);

if (tok) return tok;

}

return null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const out = [];

// Best source: handler already normalized these

if (Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) {

for (const entry of globalThis.__TARGETS) {

const tok = resolveTokenEntry(entry);

if (tok) out.push(tok);

}

}

const arrs = [

p?.targets,

p?.targetTokens,

p?.meta?.targets,

p?.meta?.targetTokens,

p?.targetTokenUuids,

p?.originalTargetUUIDs,

p?.targetTokenIds

].filter(a => Array.isArray(a));

for (const arr of arrs) {

for (const entry of arr) {

const tok = resolveTokenEntry(entry);

if (tok) out.push(tok);

}

}

// Deduplicate

const seen = new Set();

return out.filter(tok => {

const key = tok?.document?.uuid ?? tok?.id;

if (!key || seen.has(key)) return false;

seen.add(key);

return true;

});

}

const sourceToken = resolveSourceToken();

const targets = resolveTargets();

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("No caster token found in action payload.");

return;

}

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.warn("Sequencer is not active.");

return;

}

if (!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

ui.notifications.warn("ONI Pseudo Animation API is not available.");

return;

}

// -----------------------------

// Timing / tuning

// -----------------------------

const params = {

amplitude: 70, // how far left/right the blur dash goes

swings: 7, // number of side-to-side passes

swingMs: 55, // time per pass

afterimageEveryMs: 35, // how often to stamp an afterimage

afterimageFadeMs: 240, // ghost fade duration

disappearFadeMs: 120, // fast vanish at the end

hiddenHoldMs: 140, // brief empty beat before return

returnFadeMs: 520, // slow fade back in

blurStrength: 12,

zMain: 5000,

zGhost: 4990

};

const totalMs =

(params.swings * params.swingMs) +

params.disappearFadeMs +

params.hiddenHoldMs +

params.returnFadeMs + 120;

const scriptSource = `

const TAG = "[ONI][Pseudo][AfterImageBlurStep]";

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Need casterToken");

const wait = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));

function easeOutCubic(t) {

return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

}

function easeInOutSine(t) {

return -(Math.cos(Math.PI * t) - 1) / 2;

}

function animateValue(from, to, durMs, onUpdate, easing = easeInOutSine) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const tick = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easing(t);

const value = from + (to - from) * e;

onUpdate(value, t);

if (t >= 1) {

ticker.remove(tick);

resolve();

}

};

ticker.add(tick);

});

}

async function fadeSprite(sprite, from, to, durMs, easing = easeOutCubic) {

await animateValue(from, to, durMs, (value) => {

sprite.alpha = value;

}, easing);

}

async function createClone(token, alpha = 1) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

sprite.x = token.center.x;

sprite.y = token.center.y;

sprite.alpha = alpha;

if (baseObj) {

sprite.width = baseObj.width;

sprite.height = baseObj.height;

sprite.angle = baseObj.angle ?? 0;

sprite.scale.x = baseObj.scale?.x ?? sprite.scale.x;

sprite.scale.y = baseObj.scale?.y ?? sprite.scale.y;

}

sprite.zIndex = Number(params.zMain ?? 5000);

// Keep horizontal flip if token is flipped

const texScaleX = token.document.texture?.scaleX ?? 1;

const texScaleY = token.document.texture?.scaleY ?? 1;

sprite.scale.x *= Math.sign(texScaleX || 1);

sprite.scale.y *= Math.sign(texScaleY || 1);

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

return sprite;

}

async function spawnAfterimage(mainSprite, ghostBag) {

const ghost = new PIXI.Sprite(mainSprite.texture);

ghost.anchor.set(mainSprite.anchor.x, mainSprite.anchor.y);

ghost.x = mainSprite.x;

ghost.y = mainSprite.y;

ghost.width = mainSprite.width;

ghost.height = mainSprite.height;

ghost.alpha = 0.34;

ghost.angle = mainSprite.angle;

ghost.scale.x = mainSprite.scale.x;

ghost.scale.y = mainSprite.scale.y;

ghost.zIndex = Number(params.zGhost ?? 4990);

if (PIXI?.filters?.BlurFilter) {

ghost.filters = [new PIXI.filters.BlurFilter(3)];

}

canvas.stage.addChild(ghost);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

ghostBag.push(ghost);

fadeSprite(

ghost,

ghost.alpha,

0,

Number(params.afterimageFadeMs ?? 240),

easeOutCubic

).then(() => {

try {

if (ghost.parent) ghost.parent.removeChild(ghost);

ghost.destroy();

} catch (_) {}

});

}

const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

const home = { x: casterToken.center.x, y: casterToken.center.y };

let mainSprite = null;

let returnSprite = null;

const ghosts = [];

let stampTimer = null;

try {

mainSprite = await createClone(casterToken, 1);

if (PIXI?.filters?.BlurFilter) {

mainSprite.filters = [new PIXI.filters.BlurFilter(Number(params.blurStrength ?? 12))];

}

// Hide real token locally while pseudo animation runs

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

const leftX = home.x - Number(params.amplitude ?? 70);

const rightX = home.x + Number(params.amplitude ?? 70);

const swings = Number(params.swings ?? 7);

const swingMs = Number(params.swingMs ?? 55);

stampTimer = setInterval(() => {

try {

if (mainSprite) spawnAfterimage(mainSprite, ghosts);

} catch (err) {

console.warn(TAG, "afterimage spawn failed:", err);

}

}, Number(params.afterimageEveryMs ?? 35));

// Start from center, then rapidly sway left/right

let currentX = home.x;

let dir = -1;

for (let i = 0; i < swings; i++) {

const targetX = dir === -1 ? leftX : rightX;

await animateValue(currentX, targetX, swingMs, (value) => {

if (mainSprite) {

mainSprite.x = value;

mainSprite.y = home.y;

}

});

currentX = targetX;

dir *= -1;

}

// Snap back to center before vanish

await animateValue(currentX, home.x, Math.max(35, Math.floor(swingMs * 0.8)), (value) => {

if (mainSprite) {

mainSprite.x = value;

mainSprite.y = home.y;

}

});

if (stampTimer) {

clearInterval(stampTimer);

stampTimer = null;

}

// Stronger blur right before vanish

if (mainSprite && PIXI?.filters?.BlurFilter) {

mainSprite.filters = [new PIXI.filters.BlurFilter(Number(params.blurStrength ?? 12) + 4)];

}

await fadeSprite(

mainSprite,

mainSprite?.alpha ?? 1,

0,

Number(params.disappearFadeMs ?? 120),

easeOutCubic

);

if (mainSprite) {

if (mainSprite.parent) mainSprite.parent.removeChild(mainSprite);

mainSprite.destroy();

mainSprite = null;

}

// Brief gap where caster is "gone"

await wait(Number(params.hiddenHoldMs ?? 140));

// Return image fades back in at exact home position

returnSprite = await createClone(casterToken, 0);

if (PIXI?.filters?.BlurFilter) {

returnSprite.filters = [new PIXI.filters.BlurFilter(1.5)];

}

returnSprite.x = home.x;

returnSprite.y = home.y;

await fadeSprite(

returnSprite,

0,

1,

Number(params.returnFadeMs ?? 520),

easeOutCubic

);

// Small settle

if (returnSprite?.filters) returnSprite.filters = [];

await wait(40);

} finally {

try {

if (stampTimer) clearInterval(stampTimer);

} catch (_) {}

try {

if (mainSprite) {

if (mainSprite.parent) mainSprite.parent.removeChild(mainSprite);

mainSprite.destroy();

}

} catch (_) {}

try {

if (returnSprite) {

if (returnSprite.parent) returnSprite.parent.removeChild(returnSprite);

returnSprite.destroy();

}

} catch (_) {}

try {

for (const g of ghosts) {

if (!g) continue;

if (g.parent) g.parent.removeChild(g);

g.destroy();

}

} catch (_) {}

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

}

`;

try {

console.log(TAG, "START", { sourceToken, targets });

ONI.emit("oni:animationStart", {

type: ANIM_KEY,

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: targets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

// SFX only through Sequencer

await new Sequence()

.sound()

.file(SFX_URL)

.volume(0.85)

.play();

// Visuals through Pseudo only

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: targets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params,

meta: { source: "AfterImageBlurStep" }

});

// Wait for the pseudo session to finish before ending the cinematic window

await wait(totalMs);

console.log(TAG, "END");

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "Animation crashed:", err);

} finally {

ONI.emit("oni:animationEnd", {

type: ANIM_KEY,

sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null,

targetTokenIds: targets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

}

})();
props.custom_logic_resolution:
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// High Speed — Custom Logic: Resolution

// Foundry V12 / Fabula Ultima Companion / Lancer Initiative

//

// Effect handled here:

// - Give the caster +1 extra activation for the current round.

// - Restore them back to their original activation max after the round ends.

// - Uses Lancer Initiative flags:

// flags.lancer-initiative.activations.value

// flags.lancer-initiative.activations.max

//

// Important:

// - Do NOT add @local-ui-only.

// - Let CustomLogic-Resolution run through GMExecutor for player clients.

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const TAG = "[CL-RES][High Speed]";

const MODULE_ID = "fabula-ultima-companion";

const LI = "lancer-initiative";

const FLAG_KEY = "highSpeedTempActivation";

const GLOBAL_KEY = "__ONI_HIGH_SPEED_TEMP_ACTIVATION_MANAGER__";

const VERSION = 1;

// Change to true only if you intentionally want multiple High Speed boosts

// from the same actor in the same round to stack.

const ALLOW_STACKING_SAME_ROUND = false;

const CLEANUP_DELAY_MS = 100;

const p =

(typeof __PAYLOAD !== "undefined" && __PAYLOAD)

? __PAYLOAD

: (typeof payload !== "undefined" ? payload : null);

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing payload.");

return { ok: false, reason: "missing-payload" };

}

p.meta = p.meta || {};

const wait = (ms) => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

function hasOwn(obj, key) {

return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj ?? {}, key);

}

function collectionValues(collection) {

if (!collection) return [];

if (Array.isArray(collection)) return collection;

if (collection instanceof Map) return Array.from(collection.values());

if (typeof collection.values === "function") return Array.from(collection.values());

if (Array.isArray(collection.contents)) return collection.contents;

if (typeof collection === "object") return Object.values(collection);

return [];

}

function numberish(value, fallback = 0) {

const n = Number(value);

return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;

}

function readLiNumber(combatant, path, fallback = 0) {

try {

return numberish(combatant?.getFlag?.(LI, path), fallback);

} catch (_) {

return fallback;

}

}

async function setLiNumber(combatant, path, value) {

return combatant?.setFlag?.(LI, path, Math.max(0, Number(value) || 0));

}

function isSummonActor(actor) {

if (!actor) return false;

const v =

foundry.utils.getProperty(actor, "system.props.isSummon") ??

foundry.utils.getProperty(actor, "system.isSummon");

return v === true;

}

function isSummonCombatant(combatant) {

const actor =

combatant?.actor ??

(combatant?.actorId ? game.actors?.get?.(combatant.actorId) : null);

return isSummonActor(actor);

}

function getPendingActivationsTotal(combat) {

let total = 0;

for (const combatant of collectionValues(combat?.combatants)) {

if (isSummonCombatant(combatant)) continue;

const value = readLiNumber(combatant, "activations.value", 0);

total += Math.max(0, value);

}

return total;

}

function emitTurnBarRefresh(reason = "high-speed") {

try {

globalThis.__ONI_FABULA_INITIATIVE__?.refresh?.(reason);

} catch (_) {}

try {

game.socket?.emit?.(`module.${MODULE_ID}`, {

scope: "fabula-initiative",

type: "REFRESH",

reason

});

} catch (_) {}

}

async function resolveActorAndToken(uuidOrDoc) {

if (!uuidOrDoc) return { actor: null, tokenDoc: null, doc: null };

let doc = uuidOrDoc;

if (typeof uuidOrDoc === "string") {

try {

doc = await fromUuid(uuidOrDoc);

} catch (err) {

console.warn(TAG, "fromUuid failed.", {

uuidOrDoc,

error: String(err?.message ?? err)

});

return { actor: null, tokenDoc: null, doc: null };

}

}

if (!doc) return { actor: null, tokenDoc: null, doc: null };

const documentName = doc.documentName ?? doc.constructor?.name ?? "";

// TokenDocument / Token

if (documentName === "Token" || documentName === "TokenDocument") {

return {

actor: doc.actor ?? doc.object?.actor ?? null,

tokenDoc: doc.documentName === "Token" ? doc : (doc.document ?? doc),

doc

};

}

// Actor

if (documentName === "Actor") {

const activeToken =

doc.getActiveTokens?.(true, true)?.[0] ??

doc.getActiveTokens?.()?.[0] ??

null;

return {

actor: doc,

tokenDoc: activeToken?.document ?? null,

doc

};

}

// Best-effort fallback

const actor =

doc.actor ??

doc.object?.actor ??

doc.token?.actor ??

doc.parent?.actor ??

doc.document?.actor ??

null;

const tokenDoc =

doc.documentName === "Token"

? doc

: doc.document?.documentName === "Token"

? doc.document

: doc.token?.documentName === "Token"

? doc.token

: doc.token?.document?.documentName === "Token"

? doc.token.document

: null;

return { actor, tokenDoc, doc };

}

function findCombatantForActorOrToken(combat, actor, tokenDoc) {

if (!combat) return null;

const combatants = collectionValues(combat.combatants);

const actorId = actor?.id ?? null;

const actorUuid = actor?.uuid ?? null;

const tokenId = tokenDoc?.id ?? null;

const tokenUuid = tokenDoc?.uuid ?? null;

// Prefer exact token match first.

if (tokenId || tokenUuid) {

const byToken = combatants.find(c => {

const cTokenUuid = c.token?.uuid ?? c.tokenUuid ?? null;

return (

(tokenId && (c.tokenId === tokenId || c.token?.id === tokenId)) ||

(tokenUuid && cTokenUuid === tokenUuid)

);

});

if (byToken) return byToken;

}

// Fallback to actor match.

if (actorId || actorUuid) {

const byActor = combatants.find(c => {

const cActor =

c.actor ??

(c.actorId ? game.actors?.get?.(c.actorId) : null);

return (

(actorId && (c.actorId === actorId || cActor?.id === actorId)) ||

(actorUuid && cActor?.uuid === actorUuid)

);

});

if (byActor) return byActor;

}

return null;

}

async function cleanupCombat(combat, reason = "cleanup") {

if (!combat) return { ok: false, reason: "missing-combat" };

let cleaned = 0;

for (const combatant of collectionValues(combat.combatants)) {

const data = combatant?.getFlag?.(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY);

if (!data?.active) continue;

// Only clean the combat this boost was applied to.

if (data.combatId && data.combatId !== combat.id) continue;

const originalMax = Math.max(0, numberish(data.originalMax, 1));

const currentValue = readLiNumber(combatant, "activations.value", 0);

// If cleanup happens at true end-of-round, currentValue is usually 0.

// If cleanup happens after Next Round reset, currentValue may be 2.

// In both cases, cap it back to the original max.

const restoredValue = Math.min(Math.max(0, currentValue), originalMax);

try {

await setLiNumber(combatant, "activations.max", originalMax);

await setLiNumber(combatant, "activations.value", restoredValue);

await combatant.unsetFlag(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY);

cleaned++;

console.log(TAG, "Restored temporary High Speed activation.", {

reason,

combatant: combatant.name,

combatId: combat.id,

currentRound: combat.round,

originalMax,

restoredValue

});

} catch (err) {

console.warn(TAG, "Failed to restore temporary activation.", {

reason,

combatant: combatant?.name,

error: err

});

}

}

if (cleaned > 0) {

emitTurnBarRefresh(`high-speed-cleanup:${reason}`);

}

return { ok: true, cleaned };

}

async function maybeCleanupAtEndOfRound(combat) {

if (!combat) return;

await wait(CLEANUP_DELAY_MS);

// Lancer Initiative deactivation state.

if (combat.turn !== null) return;

// Same logic as your EoR announcer: the round is truly over when

// no non-summon combatants have pending activations.

const pendingTotal = getPendingActivationsTotal(combat);

if (pendingTotal > 0) return;

await cleanupCombat(combat, "end-of-round-ready");

}

function installCleanupHooksOnce() {

const old = globalThis[GLOBAL_KEY];

if (old?.installed && old.version === VERSION) return old;

// If this script was updated during testing, remove older hook version.

if (old?.hookIds?.length) {

for (const [hookName, hookId] of old.hookIds) {

try {

Hooks.off(hookName, hookId);

} catch (_) {}

}

}

const state = {

installed: true,

version: VERSION,

hookIds: []

};

const hUpdateCombat = Hooks.on("updateCombat", async (combat, changed) => {

if (!combat) return;

// True end-of-round check: current turn was cleared and all activations are spent.

if (hasOwn(changed, "turn")) {

await maybeCleanupAtEndOfRound(combat);

}

// Safety backup: if round advances before the EoR cleanup catches it,

// restore after the new round has settled.

if (hasOwn(changed, "round")) {

await wait(CLEANUP_DELAY_MS);

await cleanupCombat(combat, "round-change");

}

// Combat ending backup.

if (changed?.started === false || changed?.active === false) {

await cleanupCombat(combat, "combat-ended");

}

});

const hCombatRound = Hooks.on("combatRound", async (combat) => {

await wait(CLEANUP_DELAY_MS);

await cleanupCombat(combat, "combatRound-hook");

});

const hFabulaRoundChanged = Hooks.on("oni.fabulaInitiative.roundChanged", async (event) => {

const combat =

game.combats?.get?.(event?.combatId) ??

game.combat ??

null;

await wait(CLEANUP_DELAY_MS);

await cleanupCombat(combat, "fabula-roundChanged");

});

const hDeleteCombat = Hooks.on("deleteCombat", async (combat) => {

await cleanupCombat(combat, "deleteCombat");

});

state.hookIds.push(

["updateCombat", hUpdateCombat],

["combatRound", hCombatRound],

["oni.fabulaInitiative.roundChanged", hFabulaRoundChanged],

["deleteCombat", hDeleteCombat]

);

globalThis[GLOBAL_KEY] = state;

console.log(TAG, "Installed cleanup hooks.");

return state;

}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Main execution

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

installCleanupHooksOnce();

const combat = game.combat ?? null;

if (!combat || !combat.started) {

console.warn(TAG, "No active started combat. High Speed activation boost skipped.");

return { ok: false, reason: "no-active-started-combat" };

}

const currentRound = Number(combat.round ?? 0) || 0;

if (currentRound <= 0) {

console.warn(TAG, "Combat round is not ready yet. High Speed activation boost skipped.", {

round: combat.round

});

return { ok: false, reason: "round-not-ready" };

}

const attackerRef =

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attackerActorUuid ??

p?.attackerUuid ??

p?.meta?.casterUuid ??

p?.casterUuid ??

null;

const { actor: casterActor, tokenDoc: casterTokenDoc } = await resolveActorAndToken(attackerRef);

if (!casterActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve caster actor.", { attackerRef });

return { ok: false, reason: "caster-not-found" };

}

const combatant = findCombatantForActorOrToken(combat, casterActor, casterTokenDoc);

if (!combatant) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not find caster combatant in current combat.", {

caster: casterActor.name,

casterUuid: casterActor.uuid,

tokenUuid: casterTokenDoc?.uuid ?? null

});

return { ok: false, reason: "caster-combatant-not-found" };

}

// Clean stale old boost first, in case testing/reload left a previous flag behind.

const existingBefore = combatant.getFlag(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY);

if (

existingBefore?.active &&

existingBefore?.combatId === combat.id &&

Number(existingBefore?.appliedRound) !== currentRound

) {

await cleanupCombat(combat, "stale-before-apply");

}

const existing = combatant.getFlag(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY);

const actionCardId = String(

p?.meta?.actionCardId ??

p?.actionCardId ??

p?.meta?.sourceActionCardId ??

""

).trim();

if (

existing?.active &&

existing?.combatId === combat.id &&

Number(existing?.appliedRound) === currentRound &&

!ALLOW_STACKING_SAME_ROUND

) {

console.log(TAG, "High Speed activation already active for this combatant this round. Skipping duplicate.", {

combatant: combatant.name,

round: currentRound,

existingActionCardId: existing.actionCardId ?? null,

actionCardId: actionCardId || null

});

return {

ok: true,

skipped: true,

reason: "already-active-this-round",

combatantId: combatant.id

};

}

const oldValue = readLiNumber(combatant, "activations.value", 0);

const oldMax = readLiNumber(combatant, "activations.max", 1);

const originalValue =

existing?.active && Number.isFinite(Number(existing.originalValue))

? Number(existing.originalValue)

: oldValue;

const originalMax =

existing?.active && Number.isFinite(Number(existing.originalMax))

? Number(existing.originalMax)

: oldMax;

const existingDelta = Math.max(0, numberish(existing?.delta, 0));

const nextDelta = existingDelta + 1;

const actionCardIds = Array.from(new Set([

...(Array.isArray(existing?.actionCardIds) ? existing.actionCardIds : []),

actionCardId

].filter(Boolean).map(String)));

const flagData = {

active: true,

source: "High Speed",

combatId: combat.id,

combatantId: combatant.id,

actorUuid: casterActor.uuid,

tokenUuid: casterTokenDoc?.uuid ?? null,

appliedRound: currentRound,

originalValue,

originalMax,

delta: nextDelta,

actionId: p?.meta?.actionId ?? p?.actionId ?? null,

actionCardId: actionCardId || null,

actionCardIds,

appliedAt: Date.now(),

appliedByUserId: game.userId ?? null

};

// Match your Turn Bar Grant behavior: +1 remaining activation and +1 max activation.

await setLiNumber(combatant, "activations.max", oldMax + 1);

await setLiNumber(combatant, "activations.value", oldValue + 1);

await combatant.setFlag(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY, flagData);

emitTurnBarRefresh("high-speed-apply");

console.log(TAG, "Applied temporary High Speed activation.", {

caster: casterActor.name,

combatant: combatant.name,

round: currentRound,

value: `${oldValue} -> ${oldValue + 1}`,

max: `${oldMax} -> ${oldMax + 1}`,

restoresTo: {

valueCap: originalMax,

max: originalMax

}

});

return {

ok: true,

applied: true,

combatantId: combatant.id,

actorUuid: casterActor.uuid,

round: currentRound,

valueBefore: oldValue,

valueAfter: oldValue + 1,

maxBefore: oldMax,

maxAfter: oldMax + 1,

restoresToMax: originalMax

};
